LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionArmor.comps.0.desc: Toggle buffing nearby allies, turn off when not in combat if performance is a concern
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionArmor.description: A carefully designed and decorated set of armor made from a series of reinforced metal or wooden sheets, forming somewhat of a carapace without sacrificing too much dexterity. Such armor is known to embolden one's mental fortitude.
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionArmor.label: centurion armor
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionHelmet.description: A carefully designed and decorated helmet made out of a single large piece of wood or metal. A wide open gap near the mouth and eyes allows full peripheral vision and unmuffled communication. This particular helmet includes accoutrement to inspire both its wearers and onlookers, when fighting side by side a centurion even pain itself seems dulled.
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_CenturionHelmet.label: centurion helmet
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_LegionnaireArmor.descriptio: A carefully designed set of armor made from a series of reinforced metal or wooden sheets, forming somewhat of a carapace without sacrificing too much dexterity. Such armor is known to embolden one's mental fortitude.
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_LegionnaireArmor.label: legionnaire armor
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_LegionnaireHelmet.descripti: A carefully designed helmet made out of a single large piece of wood or metal. A wide open gap near the mouth and eyes allows full peripheral vision and unmuffled communication.
LanguageData.VFEC_Apparel_LegionnaireHelmet.label: legionnaire helmet
LanguageData.VFEC_Arrow_Scorpion.label: scorpion arrow
LanguageData.VFEC_Beacon.description: A large pile of wood placed carefully utop a tall platform. Once lit, a slow burning fire will burn brightly for 3 days. Lighting such a beacon will signal to a friendly faction that your settlement is in need of help, auxiliary military engineers usually arrive shortly afterwards, they will both fight and build alongside you. Must be fully rebuilt after extinguishing. Help can only be requests once at a time, and only every 3 days.
LanguageData.VFEC_Beacon.label: beacon
LanguageData.VFEC_BlocksConcrete.description: Sturdy, utilitarian cement blocks for crafting any sort of infrastructure. While not as durable as granite or as gorgeous as marble, it is a clear improvement over weaker materials such as slate or sandstone.
LanguageData.VFEC_BlocksConcrete.label: concrete blocks
LanguageData.VFEC_Bronze.description: A metallic alloy made from steel and trace amounts of copper found in stones. Can be used for crafting armor or furnishings when steel is in low supply.
LanguageData.VFEC_Bronze.label: bronze
LanguageData.VFEC_ConcretePress.description: A very strong, open stone basin meant to cure and shape a mixture of clay, sand, and powdered stone known as cement into blocks.
LanguageData.VFEC_ConcretePress.label: cement press
LanguageData.VFEC_CraftingBench.description: A simple bench stocked with equally simple tools meant to assist in the crafting of primitive goods and weapons.
LanguageData.VFEC_CraftingBench.label: crafting bench
LanguageData.VFEC_HeatStones.description: A thin square box made of stone, perforated with tiny holes at the bottom and top. A small fire can be lit and sustained within. The stone container will slowly dissipate heat, allowing prolonged passive warmth.
LanguageData.VFEC_HeatStones.label: heat stones
LanguageData.VFEC_Javelin.description: A long-tipped throwing spear specifically designed to break armor and shield alike.
LanguageData.VFEC_Javelin.label: javelin
LanguageData.VFEC_Javelin.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.VFEC_Javelin.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.VFEC_Javelin_Thrown.label: javelin
LanguageData.VFEC_Jerky.description: Salty, chewy, thinly-sliced meat that will last indefinitely and tastes quite pleasant for what it is.
LanguageData.VFEC_Jerky.label: jerky
LanguageData.VFEC_LargePassiveCooler.description: A sturdy unpowered cooler notably larger than the traditional variety, cools rooms to freezing via water evaporation. Will run out and self-destruct after several days.
LanguageData.VFEC_LargePassiveCooler.label: large passive cooler
LanguageData.VFEC_MeatDryingRack.description: A solid wooden rack featuring a series of dangling metal hooks across a central beam meant to hang slabs of meat. Meat hung by it will very slowly air dry over time, allowing an indefinite form of preservation. The air drying process can be quickened by a warm environment.
LanguageData.VFEC_MeatDryingRack.label: meat drying rack
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Dagger.description: A simple, elongated knife capable of being swung quite quickly. Generally favored by assassins or used as a backup weapon should one be separated from their spear or spatha.
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Dagger.label: dagger
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Dagger.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Dagger.tools.1.label: blade
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Dagger.tools.2.label: point
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Spatha.description: A weighty shortsword meant to deliver piercing attacks as well as occasional slashing swipes. Many scholars consider such a weapon to be a slightly less effective precursor to the longsword.
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Spatha.label: spatha
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Spatha.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Spatha.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.VFEC_MeleeWeapon_Spatha.tools.2.label: edge
LanguageData.VFEC_MoteCenturionLink.label: centurion link
LanguageData.VFEC_Opium.description: A particularly strong and very addictive painkiller capable of entirely nullifying one's pain. It is recommended that if one is to begin using this drug, they should become daily users, as withdrawal is extremely difficult to cope with and starts quickly.
LanguageData.VFEC_Opium.label: opium
LanguageData.VFEC_Plant_Poppy.description: A tiny, crimson flower that can be harvested for opium, a strong pain killing drug.
LanguageData.VFEC_Plant_Poppy.label: poppy
LanguageData.VFEC_Shield_Heavy.description: A heavily fortified square shield that covers one's body from shin to shoulder, heavy enough to slow those wielding it at the benefit of incredible protection.
LanguageData.VFEC_Shield_Heavy.label: heavy shield
LanguageData.VFEC_Tent.description: A small, personal tent no larger than a single person bed. When pitched, such a tent will easily protect a pawn from elements such as heat or cold, however it’s not quite as restful, as one is still laying directly on the ground.
LanguageData.VFEC_Tent.label: tent
LanguageData.VFEC_TheatreStage.description: A lightly decorated wooden stage meant to provide area for props and actors both to create compelling scenes. Such performances are quite fun for both those on stage and those casting their eyes upon it.
LanguageData.VFEC_TheatreStage.label: theatre stage
LanguageData.VFEC_Thermaebath.description: A very large, heated stone bath meant to be shared by several patrons. Provides a temporary respite from an otherwise discomforting world. When in high numbers, bathers are known to lose themselves in the moment and share more than they normally would.
LanguageData.VFEC_Thermaebath.label: thermaebath
LanguageData.VFEC_Toga.description: A semicircular, open-bottomed garment designed to cover the entire body and shoulders. While similar to tribal clothing the toga is generally made with a more delicate touch and presents itself as dignified everyday wear.
LanguageData.VFEC_Toga.label: toga
LanguageData.VFEC_TurretGun_Scorpion.description: A ballista-like turret capable of firing rapidly when set up and manned. Light enough to be used as a handheld weapon at the cost of firing speed, very effective against enemy infantry.
LanguageData.VFEC_TurretGun_Scorpion.label: scorpion
LanguageData.VFEC_Turret_Scorpion.description: A ballista-like turret capable of firing rapidly when set up and manned. Light enough to be used as a handheld weapon at the cost of firing speed, very effective against enemy infantry.
LanguageData.VFEC_Turret_Scorpion.label: scorpion turret
LanguageData.VFEC_Tyrian.description: A bolt of very beautiful and luxurious violet cloth, perfect for clothing the distinguished.
LanguageData.VFEC_Tyrian.label: tyrian
LanguageData.VFEC_TyrianFarm.description: A large wooden enclosure meant to be placed in shallow water and filled with cloth. A unique breed of snails found in many rimworlds are known to wash up and leave residue on the cloth contained within, dying it. Creates a small amount of royal fabric over time.
LanguageData.VFEC_TyrianFarm.label: tyrian farm
LanguageData.VFEC_Weapon_Scorpion.description: A ballista-like turret capable of firing rapidly when set up and manned. Light enough to be used as a handheld weapon at the cost of firing speed, very effective against enemy infantry.
LanguageData.VFEC_Weapon_Scorpion.label: scorpion
LanguageData.VFEC_Weapon_Scorpion.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.VFEC_WoodFiredCrematorium.description: A wood fired receptacle meant for disposal of unneeded junk or bodies.
LanguageData.VFEC_WoodFiredCrematorium.label: wood-fired crematorium
LanguageData.VFEC_Wreath.description: A polished metallic piece of headgear resembling laurels meant to signify wealth and status, equally appealing to both senators and nobles.
LanguageData.VFEC_Wreath.label: wreath
